# MVP plan: Perkeep as an Immich backend (albums + photos, read-only)

Author notes / decisions
=======================
* The file `immich.go` in this dir is NOT ours to edit. It is generated by
  oapi-codegen v2.8.0 (see gen.go) from immich-openapi-specs.json. Do not
  hand-edit it; regenerate via `go generate`.
* Hand-written code lives in `server.go` (Server + helpers) and
  `store_perkeep.go` (the Perkeep-backed store). As store queries are wired,
  helpers may be split into album.go / asset.go / timeline.go / convert.go /
  thumbnail.go.
* The generated file already provides an `Unimplemented` struct whose methods
  all reply `http.StatusNotImplemented`. That is the correct base for an MVP:
  embed `immich.Unimplemented`, override only the read handlers we serve, and
  let every other endpoint stay 501. This "stub out what is not clear" is done
  for free and stays in sync with the spec on regeneration.
* The rest of the Perkeep source (perkeep.org/pkg/blob, blobserver, index,
  search, schema, client, auth) IS present in this checkout (it is a full
  module rooted at perkeep.org, go 1.25.3). The package compiles and tests in
  place:  CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./pkg/server/immich/...
  The real Perkeep-backed store lives in store_perkeep.go; hand-written stubs
  that build without the full tree are unnecessary and were removed.

Scope for this first pass
=========================
Serve albums and photos, READ ONLY. Concretely the generated interface methods
we intend to override:

  Albums (read)
    GetAllAlbums(w, r, GetAllAlbumsParams)                 // GET /albums
    GetAlbumInfo(w, r, UUID, GetAlbumInfoParams)           // GET /albums/{id}
    GetAlbumStatistics(w, r)                               // GET /albums/statistics
  Photos / assets (read)
    GetTimeBuckets(w, r, GetTimeBucketsParams)             // GET /timeline/buckets
    GetTimeBucket(w, r, GetTimeBucketParams)               // GET /timeline/bucket
    GetAssetInfo(w, r, UUID, GetAssetInfoParams)           // GET /assets/{id}
    DownloadAsset(w, r, UUID, DownloadAssetParams)         // GET /assets/{id}/original
    ViewAsset(w, r, UUID, ViewAssetParams)                 // GET /assets/{id}/thumbnail
  Search (used by mobile/desktop timelines)
    SearchAssets(w, r, SearchAssetsParams)                 // POST /search/metadata
    SearchAssetStatistics(w, r)                            // POST /search/statistics
  Server handshake (needed before Immich UI will talk to us at all)
    GetServerVersion(w, r)                                 // GET /server/version
    PingServer(w, r)                                       // GET /server/ping
    GetServerConfig(w, r)  (deprecated upstream)           // GET /server/config
    GetSupportedMediaTypes(w, r)                           // GET /server/media-types
    GetMyUser(w, r) / GetAuthStatus(w, r)                  // GET /users/me, /auth/status
    GetServerStatistics(w, r)                              // GET /server/statistics

Everything else (writes: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, albums CRUD mutations, upload,
people, faces, maps, memories, tags, shared links, stacks, trash, sessions,
admin, jobs/queues, workflows, plugins, partners, cluster groups) stays on the
embedded `immich.Unimplemented` => HTTP 501 for now. That is acceptable for the
MVP and keeps the diff small.

Non-goals (deferred, list for later passes)
===========================================
- Any write path (upload, metadata write, delete/trash, album/asset mutations).
- Album asset listing in place: the real client pulls album contents via
  GetTimeBucket with `albumId` set; that is how an album's photos render.
  GetAlbumInfo returns counts and thumbnail id only.
- Search for people/places/smart/clip, OCR, faces, map markers, memories,
  shared links, sync (POST /sync/stream incremental deltas), HLS video,
  duplicate detection, libraries, partners.
- Video playback / transcoding; only still images first.
- Multi-user / authz model beyond a single implicit owner user.
- Image thumbnails generated on the fly: MVP returns existing Perkeep
  thumbnails only (no resize), and /assets/{id}/thumbnail serves the raw blob
  scaled by the client if needed. (STUB)
- Deterministic /stable UUID mapping back and forth (see open question below):
  MVP uses a content-addressed stable UUID derived from the Perkeep blob ref so
  re-listing an album yields the same asset ids.

What "photos" means in Perkeep terms
====================================
A Perkeep photo is a schema permanode ("file" or image permanode) whose content
is a blob ref (the image bytes) plus metadata in blobinfo / search index:
  - permanode camliVersion=1, camliType="permanode", camliContent=<image blob ref>
  - attributes: camliContentImage (larger), camliImage (thumbnail family),
    camliTime / datePublished / taken, camliTitle, gps, tags...
  - The blobserver holds the raw bytes; search index gives permanent
    "file" metadata; thumbnails come from perkeep.org/pkg/images / thumbcache.
Queries will go through perkeep.org/pkg/search (SearchQuery, DescribeRequest)
and perkeep.org/pkg/blobserver gethandler for raw bytes. The exact fields to
map onto AssetResponseDto (taken time, original filename, checksum, exif w/h,
favorite/archive flags) come from the file permanode's blobinfo + the
search index describe response. (STUB: field-by-field mapping to be confirmed
in store_perkeep.go once the queries are wired.)

Current file layout (package immich)
=====================================
  immich.go            - GENERATED (oapi-codegen). Do not hand-edit.
  immich-openapi-specs.json - GENERATED source spec.
  gen.go               - go:generate lines.
  server.go            - Server type: embeds the generated Unimplemented, holds
                         a *store, and overrides the read endpoints + helpers
                         (owner user, error/JSON writers, version).
  store_perkeep.go     - store: holds the real Perkeep deps (*search.Handler,
                         blobserver.Storage); each query method is TODO[STUB]
                         until the search.API wiring is decided.
  server_test.go       - smoke tests for the store-independent handshake
                         endpoints, driven through the generated chi router.

Further split (album.go / asset.go / timeline.go / convert.go / thumbnail.go)
can happen as each store query is implemented; there is deliberately NO
Store interface and NO in-memory fake -- the package builds only against the
real Perkeep tree, which is present in this module.

Reference method signatures (verbatim from generated ServerInterface)
=====================================================================
  GetAllAlbums(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, params GetAllAlbumsParams)
  GetAlbumInfo(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id openapi_types.UUID, params GetAlbumInfoParams)
  GetAlbumStatistics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetTimeBuckets(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, params GetTimeBucketsParams)
  GetTimeBucket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, params GetTimeBucketParams)
  GetAssetInfo(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id openapi_types.UUID, params GetAssetInfoParams)
  DownloadAsset(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id openapi_types.UUID, params DownloadAssetParams)
  ViewAsset(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id openapi_types.UUID, params ViewAssetParams)
  SearchAssets(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, params SearchAssetsParams)
  SearchAssetStatistics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetServerVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  PingServer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetServerConfig(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetSupportedMediaTypes(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetMyUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetAuthStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
  GetServerStatistics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)

Request bodies are decoded by the generated ServerInterfaceWrapper before the
handler is called; the response DTOs (AlbumResponseDto, AssetResponseDto,
TimeBucketResponseDto, UserResponseDto, SearchResponseDto, ...) are all already
defined in immich.go and should be marshalled straight back. Handlers never
hand-decode the body.

Per-endpoint plan (what each override returns)
==============================================
GetServerVersion  -> ServerVersionResponseDto{Version:"x.y.z", Major,Minor,Patch
                    from perkeep buildinfo or fixed "0.0.1"). (STUB buildinfo).
PingServer        -> PingResponseDto{Res:"pong"}; trivially always 200.
GetServerConfig/GetServerFeatures/GetServerConfigDefaults -> fixed/simple
                    config DTO (mostly empty/false fields). Immich may call
                    these on connect. (STUB shape).
GetSupportedMediaTypes -> SupportedMediaTypesDto with the image mime set Perkeep
                    can hand back (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp,
                    image/tiff). (STUB exact dto name).
GetMyUser         -> UserResponseDto for a synthesized owner (email from
                    config/blank, name "perkeep", id = our stable owner UUID).
GetAuthStatus/GetServerStatistics -> minimal truthful values.
GetAllAlbums      -> run a Perkeep search for permanodes tagged/typed as album;
                    map each to AlbumResponseDto with counts; honor
                    GetAllAlbumsParams (id/name/isOwned/isShared filters) where
                    trivially expressible, else ignore (STUB note).
GetAlbumInfo      -> single AlbumResponseDto for {id}; 404 if not found.
GetAlbumStatistics-> AlbumStatisticsResponseDto (owned/shared/notShared counts;
                    MVP counts owned=len(albums) or 0).
GetTimeBuckets    -> group assets by date, return []TimeBucketsResponseDto; MVP
                    may return one bucket per day derived from file permanode
                    "taken" dates; honor params.AlbumId to restrict to an album.
                    Other filters ignored in pass 1 (STUB note).
GetTimeBucket     -> []AssetResponseDto for the assets whose date falls in the
                    given bucket; returns the images an album shows when
                    albumId is set. This is the workhorse for the Immich UI.
GetAssetInfo      -> AssetResponseDto for {id}; 404 if unknown blob/permanode.
DownloadAsset     -> stream original bytes: resolve {id}->blob ref, set
                    Content-Type/Length, copy from gethandler/storage.
ViewAsset         -> serve thumbnail image bytes (existing Perkeep thumbnail,
                    raw if none; see thumbnail.go STUB). Respect the requested
                    size params if present (best-effort).
SearchAssets      -> POST body MetadataSearchDto; map onto a Perkeep search
                    (date range / album / text) => SearchResponseDto
                    {assets:{total,count,items:[AssetResponseDto]}}. STUB
                    facets. Support minimal fields only.
SearchAssetStatistics -> AssetStatsResponseDto (images/total/videos counts).

Integration / where Server gets mounted
=======================================
The generated code emits a chi router helper (HandlerFromMux / HandlerWithOptions
plus ServerInterfaceWrapper). To expose it inside a Perkeep server we:
  1. Build `srv := immich.NewServer(st)` (st built from a *search.Handler and
     blobserver.Storage in the perkeepd wiring).
  2. Mount `immich.HandlerFromMux(srv, r)` under some prefix on the top-level
     perkeep.org/pkg/server mux (e.g. under /immich/ or at root for a dedicated
     Immich process), wrapped by the existing perkeep auth + httputil middleware.
The exact mount point & whether Immich should hit a sub-path is a config
decision (STUB).

Open questions / STUB decisions to confirm next pass
====================================================
1. ID model: Immich ids are UUIDs. Do we
   (a) map each Perkeep permanode/blobref 1:1 to a stable UUID derived from its
       ref (deterministic, e.g. first 16 bytes of the sha1 as a UUID), or
   (b) need a real persistent mapping table for client round-trips?
   MVP proposes (a) with reversible lookup blobref<->uuid. STUB until the
   client's id handling is verified.
2. What marks a Perkeep object as an "album"? (tag? a naming convention? a
   directory permanode listing file permanodes?) Albums in Immich are ordered
   collections; Perkeep has no first-class album. Decide the source of truth
   and the ordering semantics. STUB.
3. Metadata source: which blobinfo fields back each AssetResponseDto field
   (fileCreatedAt/fileModifiedAt, exifInfo, checksum, originalPath, owner).
   Resolve in convert.go against real search Describe output.
4. Timezone/grouping: Immich buckets are local-day; Perkeep stores UTC taken
   time. Grouping/bucket labelling ("YYYY-MM-DD") must match Immich's local
   expectation; likely client-side tz. STUB.
5. Single owner user assumption ok for MVP? Multi-user + authz later.
6. Router wiring location + prefix (handler.go).
7. Whether Immich onboarding requires /api-key usage or session cookie login;
   MVP may fake GetAuthStatus + GetMyUser so the UI proceeds read-only.
8. Thumbnails: reuse perkeep thumbcache or generate via internal/images. STUB.

First-pass implementation order (done so far)
=============================================
 1. server.go: Server struct + NewServer over *store (embedded Unimplemented).
 2. Ping + GetServerVersion + GetServerConfig + GetMyUser + GetAuthStatus +
    GetSupportedMediaTypes + GetServerStatistics (store-independent handshake).
 3. server_test.go smoke tests through the generated chi router.
 4. NEXT: wire the real store queries in store_perkeep.go, splitting helpers
    into album.go / asset.go / timeline.go / convert.go / thumbnail.go as each
    query takes shape, and add a corpus-backed test.

Acceptance criteria for the MVP
===============================
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./pkg/server/immich/` passes; `Server` satisfies
  `ServerInterface` via embedding.
- With a small Perkeep corpus, an Immich client can: connect, see a version,
  list albums, open an album and see its photos (timeline/bucket calls), view a
  photo and its thumbnail, download the original.
- All not-yet-served endpoints answer 501 and never panic.
- A corpus-backed test asserts GetTimeBucket / GetAlbumInfo return the expected
  JSON for a real (small) Perkeep index.
